source_document.title: Water Quality Report 2024
source_document.notes: The 2024 report contains a Water Quality Analysis labeled 2023. Level Found values are averages of applicable facility results; the report states that ND results were assigned zero when calculating those averages. The Spring Water column aggregates applicable facilities and does not identify individual spring sources. Internal and third-party laboratories are both described in the report, so no single analysis_provider is asserted for this table. The table reports Bicarb.Alkalinity at 65 mg/L HCO3 for Spring Water. Because the source explicitly reports this value on an HCO3 mass basis, the fixture normalizes it to the existing bicarbonate ion concentration field; it is not derived from the separately reported total alkalinity.
